notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
We’ve just released a major update to our demo! Here's what’s new:

All-New Protagonist Animations – Every animation has been reworked for a smoother and more dynamic experience.


New Enemies & a Fearsome Boss – Face fresh challenges with newly added enemies and an epic new boss battle!


Upgrade Shop Added – Collect resources and spend them on powerful upgrades in our brand-new shop system.


Complete UI Overhaul – The entire user interface has been redesigned to be more intuitive and polished.


Refined Combat System – We’ve fine-tuned the combat mechanics for a more responsive and satisfying experience.

Jump back in and explore the enhanced demo—your feedback is more valuable than ever!
